title: Trailer teaser
description: Fifteen seconds of the trailer, filmed in the game: the Spire Wyrm wakes.

title: Nebula Fields
description: Rolling Chorus Moss islands under forests of giant glowing Lumineshrooms.

title: Chorus Thicket
description: Chorus trees of pale Chorus Wood, crowned in bloom.

title: Glimmering Crags
description: Nightstone peaks grown through with teal Glimmer Crystal.

title: Resonant Spire
description: A Resonant Spire, and the Spire Wyrm that nests atop it.

title: The Spire Wyrm, asleep
description: The Spire Wyrm coiled asleep on its nest atop a Resonant Spire. Don't wake it.

title: Whalefall
description: The skeleton of a Star Leviathan, adrift in the void.

title: Ashen Barrens
description: The dead country: pale shelves and old bones under green and gold auroras.

title: The Corona
description: Sunscorched mesas, Flarebloom fields and glowing lichen, where Sunstorms rage.

title: Comet Wake
description: Scorched islands pocked with impact craters and spires of blue ice.

title: Hollow Isles
description: Dim forests of twisted Nullwood on ring-shaped islands, Upwells underneath.

title: Drift Whale
description: A huge, gentle whale that swims through the void, its spots glowing like deep-sea light. Ride it with a Chorus Flower on a Stick.

title: Void Wanderer
description: A purpur sentinel of the End's builders that studies you, if you hold still.

title: End Pollinator
description: A little drifter that spreads glowing plants through the Nebula Fields.

title: A live comet
description: Ride its tail with an elytra, or knock a chunk off its head.

title: Rift Maw
description: The fossil skull of a Star Leviathan. Its throat is a way across the End.

title: The creatures
description: Every creature of the Astral End, from the End Pollinator to the Spire Wyrm.

title: The blocks
description: Every full block the Astral End adds.
